title: Valparaíso: Funiculares, cerros y bohemia portuaria
goal: Investigate the steep urban topography of Valparaíso, 19th-century maritime commerce, and historic funicular lifts.
grammar: urbanismo vertical de Valparaíso, funiculares y oraciones de relativo locativo con cuyo

items: Analyze the amphitheater bay topography and hillside architecture.

Deploy port architecture, funicular lifts, and bohemian identity vocabulary (funicular, anfiteatro, bohemia, cerro).
